question: Does enabling sparse solver scheduling for the default ReactionTransitionComparison scene reduce editor-mode frame cost?
single_change: Set sparse_solver from false (application default) to true; keep per-workgroup channel mask false and every other setting fixed.
hypothesis: The three plates' local contacts activate less than their full top surfaces, so sparse workgroup scheduling should lower Pass 1 and Pass 2 cost.
correctness: Compare same-step State arrays bytewise and require zero negative and nonfinite values. Record actual viewport and runtime settings from the benchmark outputs.
limitations: Benchmark mode fixes one simulation step per frame. It measures editor UI rendering but does not reproduce interactive wall-clock catch-up steps or the user's exact window layout.
